// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// The READ half of the SchoolInvitation classification (ruling R2). Its sibling
// bad-ops-deletes-school-invitation.txt proves the writes are refused; this
// proves the browse is, which is the reason the model is LOOKUP_ONLY rather
// than ADULT_READABLE and not a detail of it.
//
// Deliberately placed in the declared READ chokepoint, with a `select:` and a
// bounded `take`, so nothing else can be what refuses it: no
// OPS-MUTATION-MODULE (findMany is not a write), no OPS-PRISMA-IMPORT (this
// module may hold the client), no OPS-UNPROJECTED-READ (the columns are
// named). The CLASSIFICATION is the only thing standing in the way, which is
// exactly what this fixture is for.
//
// The near miss the model invites, and it looks helpful: a support screen
// listing outstanding invitations. It is the same screen MailSuppression is
// LOOKUP_ONLY to prevent, one model along — answering "does this one teacher
// have an open offer" is support; listing every teacher currently being
// courted by a school is a register, about adults' employment, that nobody
// asked for.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function outstandingInvitations() {
  return db.schoolInvitation.findMany({
    where: { state: "PENDING" },
    select: { id: true, invitedName: true, invitedByName: true, expiresAt: true },
    take: 50,
  });
}
